name: SysML v2 Pilot Implementation
description: The official SysML v2 reference and pilot implementation, including textual editing, parsing and validation, a Jupyter kernel, visualization, standard libraries, and API support.
editorialNote: Imported from the UMLChina SysML v2 tools collection. The English summary is a concise editorial translation; capability fields remain Unknown unless the source explicitly states support.
sourceDescriptionZh: OMG维护的SysML v2官方参考实现/试验实现。它长期伴随SysML v2规范开发，是很多商业和开源工具实现SysML v2时的重要参考。包括Eclipse文本编辑器、SysML/KerML解析与验证、Jupyter Kernel、模型可视化、标准模型库以及Systems Modeling API支持。

sysmlV2Api.note: Provided by a dedicated API / Services component.

classificationNotes: The editor, notebook, and API Services are separable components of the pilot release.
